name: Blokette
summary: Blokette , a microtrend popularized on TikTok, was coined by the fashion commentary podcast Nymphet Alumni in late 2022.
description:
Blokette , a microtrend popularized on TikTok, was coined by the fashion commentary podcast Nymphet Alumni in late 2022. This aesthetic blends elements of Blokecore and Coquette styles. [ 1 ] Blokecore involves masculine-leaning pieces such as oversized football jerseys, vintage sports jackets, and Adidas Sambas, drawing from a simplified interpretation of English pub and sports culture. In contrast, the Coquette aesthetic is hyper-feminine, focusing on elements like mini skirts, knee-high socks, and hair ribbons.

The core concept of Blokette lies in combining these traditionally masculine and feminine pieces to create a contrast in gender presentation. It incorporates items like football shirts, athletic sweaters and jackets with ballet flats, leg warmers, pleated wool skirts, and hair ribbons. This fusion results in a bold mix of colors, logos, and stripes from sportswear combined with the softer tones and textures of lace, silk, and chiffon. While the trend has been embraced by fashion figures such as Bella Hadid and Ruby Lyn, it also reflects experimentation with gender expression in contemporary fashion, emphasizing a playful and often self-aware approach to styling. [ 2 ]
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Combining masculine and feminine elements, playful gender expression, visual contrast
